legend.en: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

legend.en: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

effect.en: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

legend.en: The Space Wolves fight with a savage fury that enables them to overcome even the most resilient targets.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit is selected to fight.

legend.en: Space Wolves officers rein in their warriors’ impulsive fury, repositioning them to strike exposed flanks.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One unengaged BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend.en: Severe losses only drive Blood Claws and Wulfen forward into the midst of the foe.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BLOOD CLAWS/THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY/WULFEN unit has shot.

effect.en: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

legend.en: Once a pack of Fenrisian warriors has perceived some slight weakness in the defences of a foe, they all strike at once, like encircling predators dragging down their prey.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

legend.en: Be it the power of belief or something a little more eldritch, the Space Wolves’ trust in their various protective amulets and totems is often borne out.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit suffers a mortal wound.

effect.en: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

legend.en: Fighting as one, these champions of Fenris fall upon an enemy champion and drag them down with single-minded savagery.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to fight.

legend.en: Even the most challenging terrain or formidable fortifications cannot stop the Great Wolf’s chief hunters once they are in motion.

when.en: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

legend.en: Pivotal as they are to the Great Wolf’s plans, this pack have their own orders to fulfil in this moment that come directly from Grimnar himself.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: These champions of Fenris respond to enemy fire with instinctive swiftness, rarely giving their foes a second chance to shoot at them.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit has shot.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
